root_cause: The scheduled content growth learner consumed only a static repository event/research snapshot while owned actual social metrics and consented website interactions remained in Supabase. This prevented per-post likes/comments/views and real blog/page CTA progression from influencing next-day learning.

observed_evidence.instagram: Recent 5 view-measured posts: 253 views, 1 like, 0 comments in observed available 30-day snapshot; not causal proof.
observed_evidence.linkedin: LinkedIn provider often supplies reactions only, not views.
observed_evidence.website: Page/click aggregate excludes robots and requires consent; no per-page order attribution implied.

fix: Add bounded tenant-isolated read-only Supabase provider extractor to the one existing scheduled Content growth learning job, and a deterministic per-post/per-page diagnostic and small next-day hypothesis list into its existing output. Source/access errors must be explicit, not green.
prevention_rule: No new scheduler, database, provider collector, anonymous visitor identification, unsupported claims of a reason, zero views from absent denominators, or inferred orders. Optimizations require verified mature source windows and existing experiment/publication guardrails, followed by provider and outcome readback.
terminal_rule: Protected Required/CodeQL, merged daily source, real scheduled read-only source_state=READ_ONLY_PROVIDER_OBSERVED and measured next-day outcome evidence are separate requirements.
